laws.rule: Since 2 February 2026, non-residents pay EUR 2 to enter the inner area around the Trevi Fountain in Rome. Entry is free for Rome residents, under-6s, people with disabilities and a companion, and MIC Card holders. Buy online or at Tourist Info Points; payment at the site is by card only.
